name: Preacher
summary: Some inquisitors wander the land to spread the true word of their faith.
mechanicalNotes: Determination shares one daily pool across Aggression, Defense, and Warning. Each teamwork feat slot can be traded for one extra daily use.

features.name: Determination (Ex)
features.summary: Determination grants one use per day starting at 3rd level. Aggression rerolls your own attack before the outcome is announced. Warning makes an attacker reroll a melee or ranged attack that would hit an ally who can hear you, is in sight, and is not helpless. Both are free actions and the new roll stands. Defense is an immediate action that gives you a +4 insight bonus to AC against one melee or ranged attack that would hit you. Each bonus teamwork feat slot can instead grant one more daily use. Determination replaces Solo Tactics.

resourceActions.label: Determination — Aggression

confirmations.label: You just made an attack roll and its result has yet to be revealed

resourceActions.summary: Reroll your attack with the original attack modifier and use the second result.

resourceActions.label: Determination — Defense

confirmations.label: The incoming attack is melee or ranged

resourceActions.summary: Apply a +4 insight bonus to AC against this attack only. Include any existing insight bonus in the current AC.

resourceActions.label: Determination — Warning

confirmations.label: A melee or ranged attack would hit an ally in your line of sight
The ally can hear you and is able to defend themselves

resourceActions.summary: Reroll the incoming attack with the attacker's original modifier. The attacker uses the second result.
